All requested features have been implemented and tested on branch `batch-durable`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **[`EventListener.BatchDurable`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/event.go#L1025-L1027)**
   - Added `BatchDurable func(BatchDurableInfo)` callback to [`EventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/event.go#L924).
   - Fires exactly once per sync commit after the WAL sync completes, including on failure.
   - Non-sync commits and `DisableWAL` commits never trigger the callback.
   - Updated [`EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/event.go#L1033) and wired through [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/event.go#L1234).

2. **[`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L33-L42)**
   - Carries `JobID int`, `SeqNum base.SeqNum`, `Err error`, `ApplyDuration time.Duration`, `SyncDuration time.Duration`, `CorrelationID uint64`, `BatchSize int`, and `KeyCount uint32`.
   - `ApplyDuration` and `SyncDuration` represent measured wall-clock durations and are positive for successful sync commits.

3. **[`WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/options.go#L409-L412)**
   - Added `CommitCorrelationID uint64` to [`WriteOptions`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/options.go#L399) and passed through to `BatchDurableInfo.CorrelationID`.

4. **Durability Wait and Notification Methods on [`DB`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go)**
   - [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L391) / [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L398): Blocks until sequence number is durable; seqNum 0 succeeds after any commit.
   - [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L463) / [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L470): Blocks until every sequence number in a slice is durable; nil/empty returns nil immediately.
   - [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L486) / [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L493): Waits by callback job ID. Returns an error containing `"expired"` if outside the bounded retention window, or an error containing `"unknown"` for never-seen/zero IDs.
   - [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L560): Returns `(base.SeqNum, error)` representing the highest durable sequence number and the first latched error.
   - [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L571): Pre-filled receive-only channel (`<-chan error`) that delivers nil on success or a non-nil error on WAL sync failure or DB close. Bounded outstanding subscriptions return an immediate non-nil error when full.
   - [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L605): Returns [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L60) snapshot (`HighestDurableSeqNum`, `FirstErr`, `PendingWaiters`, `TotalDurableCommits`, `TotalFailedCommits`, `CumulativeSyncDuration`, `MaxSyncDuration`). All fields start at zero, and `PendingWaiters` reflects the number of goroutines actively blocked in wait APIs.
   - Durability and DB close errors take precedence over context cancellation in all context-accepting variants.
   - All waiters unblock with an error on DB close.
   - When `DisableWAL` is true, all wait APIs and `DurabilityNotify` return nil immediately.

5. **[`Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/metrics.go#L382-L387)**
   - Added `DurableCommitCount uint64` and `DurableCommitDuration time.Duration` (cumulative WAL sync phase time), accumulated only when `BatchDurable` is configured.

6. **Tests & Git Commit**
   - Comprehensive test suite in [`durability_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability_test.go) covering callback execution, correlation IDs, context cancellation precedence, timeout/failure paths, `DisableWAL`, DB close waiter unblocking, and metric accumulation conditions.
   - All tests passing.
   - All changes committed to branch `batch-durable`.

   - [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L391) / [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-fbx417gi/durability.go#L398): Blocks until sequence number is durable; seqNum 0 succeeds after any commit.
